mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the signal is always active.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is less than 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 4.0% signal robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the t-test for mean return in this regime versus baseline is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (>0.25pp) and CPIAUCSL below 255.0 indicates accommodative monetary policy with low inflation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through interaction effects.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline > 0.25pp in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL < 255.0
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction effect (difference in returns between triggered and non-triggered) is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Residential housing starts above 1250 thousand units (HOUST > 1250) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in the strong housing market regime.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1250, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 105.0, or the mean return in this regime is not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Positive trends in retail sales (RSAFS) reflect strong consumer spending that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the signal is always active.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP level above 19000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 19000) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 19000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 150000) indicate robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and equity market performance, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the signal is always active.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 150000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
